run_coverage_check: run the litellm logging code coverage check to find untested static methods
extract_static_methods: extract all static method names from a Python file using AST parsing
find_test_calls: find all function calls made in logging test files within a directory
review_coverage_gap: review the gap between static methods in litellm_logging.py and their test coverage
summarize_untested_functions: summarize which static methods in litellm_logging.py lack test coverage
